Problem Statement
Read the units of electricity used by a machine and the price of one unit. Print the total bill.
Description
A machine in a workshop uses some units of electricity in a month. The price of one unit is given. Read both values, find the total bill, and print it with exactly 2 digits after the decimal point.
Input Description
The first line has an integer, the units used. (1 <= units <= 1000). The second line has a real number, the price of one unit, with at most 2 digits after the decimal point. (0.5 <= price <= 100)
Output Description
Print the total bill with exactly 2 digits after the decimal point.
Sample Input
120
6.5
Sample Output
780.00
